8260.title: ACP extension compaction notifications are discarded
8260.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP notification handler returns for every method other than session/update, so reported top-level compaction notifications cannot reach compaction tracking or timeline translation.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed and unmerged; synthetic tests cannot establish the actual agent's automatic notification contract.

8260.proposedFix: First capture automatic-compaction notifications from the actual agent. If the reported shape is confirmed and vendor support is intended, normalize a validated, dialect-scoped notification into the existing compaction pipeline, with identity, session scoping, and manual-echo deduplication tests.
8260.caveats: Synthetic transport replay repeated cleanly; actual automatic compaction, token usage, vendor version, and live UI remain unverified. No fix PR opened.
